definitions.explanation: A chemical substance added to food, wood, or other materials to prevent decay, rot, or spoilage.

examples.japanese: この{食品|しょくひん}には{防腐剤|ぼうふざい}が{入|はい}っていない。
{防腐剤|ぼうふざい}{不使用|ふしよう}の{商品|しょうひん}が{人気|にんき}だ。
{木材|もくざい}に{防腐剤|ぼうふざい}を{塗|ぬ}って{長持|ながも}ちさせる。
examples.english: Apply antiseptic to the wood to make it last longer.

notes:
FORMS:
{防腐|ぼうふ} (preventing decay) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation). {防腐|ぼうふ} is {防|ぼう} (prevent) + {腐|ふ} (rot, decay).

USAGE:
Used in food labeling, woodworking, and chemistry contexts. In food-related discussions, often appears in the phrase {防腐剤|ぼうふざい}{不使用|ふしよう} (preservative-free) or {無添加|むてんか} (no additives).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {保存料|ほぞんりょう}: preservative (food industry term)
- {添加物|てんかぶつ}: additive
- {防|ぼう}カビ{剤|ざい}: mold inhibitor
